name: 2-Channel Relay Module
description: GPIO-controlled relay module for switching AC/DC loads. Active LOW.

operations.name: relay_on
operations.desc: Turn on a relay channel (active LOW — set GPIO to 0)
operations.returns: JSON with pin and value set

operations.name: relay_off
operations.desc: Turn off a relay channel (set GPIO to 1)
operations.returns: JSON with pin and value set
